name: Walchenseecamp
beschreibung: The Walchenseecamp is located in Tirol, Österreich, directly on the shore of the Walchensees. The location offers direct access to the lake and a view of the surrounding mountains. The atmosphere is quiet and connected to nature, characterized by the lake and mountain landscape. In the surroundings there are hiking trails for various difficulty levels. In winter, ski areas in the region are reachable. The site has basic facilities with sanitary facilities and pitches for tents and motorhomes. Guests can expect a stay with opportunities for relaxation and nature experiences by the water and in the mountains.
